description: Reads the business's video series and every video type each one is made with, as the Series page's video type editor shows them: each type's name, shape (what happens in it), looks (drawn: motion graphics made in code; clips: AI video; stills; mix), who is heard and in which voice, music, words on screen, length in seconds, pictures (made or real), research, how many a week, whether each waits for the owner's yes first, quality, the 4K copy, the films the owner liked and its faces, with what one episode and a month of it may use in tokens. Also each series' state, where its episodes come from, the episode budget the owner kept at Start (the most an episode goes ahead at without a card), its characters (who can narrate or speak) and the voices a voice-over can use (the project's kept ones and the stock ones). Reading spends nothing.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

series.description: one series, by its id or exact name; leave out for every video series
